description: Returns a URL where the end customer accepts BlindPay's terms of service. A person must open it in a browser and accept; it cannot be accepted through the API. After acceptance the browser is sent to redirect_url with tos_id as a query parameter, and a tos.accept webhook fires. Pass that tos_id (to_...) to Create Customer. idempotency_key is any unique string and cannot be reused.
